data.planText:
{
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "greet-implement",
      "title": "Implement greet.js",
      "description": "Create src/greet.js exporting greet(name) and shout(str) functions that satisfy the greet test suite.",
      "fileScope": ["src/greet.js"],
      "referenceFiles": ["test/greet.test.js"],
      "verify": ["node", "--test", "test/greet.test.js"],
      "acceptance": [
        "greet('Ada') returns 'Hello, Ada!'",
        "greet trims whitespace and throws on empty string",
        "shout converts to uppercase and appends '!'"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "slug-implement",
      "title": "Implement slug.js",
      "description": "Create src/slug.js exporting slugify(str) function that satisfies the slug test suite.",
      "fileScope": ["src/slug.js"],
      "referenceFiles": ["test/slug.test.js"],
      "verify": ["node", "--test", "test/slug.test.js"],
      "acceptance": [
        "slugify('Hello World') returns 'hello-world'",
        "slugify strips punctuation and collapses separators",
        "slugify throws on input that results in empty string"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "wordcount-implement",
      "title": "Implement wordcount.js",
      "description": "Create src/wordcount.js exporting countWords(str) and topWords(str, limit) functions that satisfy the wordcount test suite.",
      "fileScope": ["src/wordcount.js"],
      "referenceFiles": ["test/wordcount.test.js"],
      "verify": ["node", "--test", "test/wordcount.test.js"],
      "acceptance": [
        "countWords counts whitespace-separated words correctly",
        "topWords returns most frequent words lower-cased, ties broken alphabetically",
        "topWords respects limit and returns empty list for no words"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
